https://www.breitbart.com/border/2026/08.text: Four members of the terrorist organization known as Cartel Jalisco New Generation (CJNG) are facing federal charges in the United States in connection with the purchase of RPGs, machine guns, mortars, and other weapons from the Czech Republic, as well as the production and smuggling of drugs into the United States. This week, four men from CJNG went before a U.S. federal judge in Florida, where they had their first appearance in connection with a series of charges detailed in a criminal indictment. The four men, who are from Mexico, had been originally arrested in the Czech Republic and extradited to the United States. The men are identified as 44-year-old Edgar Alejandro Lopez Velazco, 33-year-old Noe Diaz Jimenez, 63-year-old Leobardo Gaxiola “Bado” Lopez, and 23-year-old Jose Miguel Alvarado Morales. All four men are facing a variety of drug conspiracy charges related to terrorism, narco-terrorism, drug trafficking, and firearms trafficking. All four face a maximum sentence of life in prison. According to federal prosecutors, Lopez Velazco acted as the representative of a top leader with CJNG; Diaz Jimenez was a fentanyl trafficker who had a drug manufacturing lab in Mexico; Gaxiola Lopez worked as an arms and drug broker for CJNG, while Alvarado Morales was the representative of another top CJNG leader. Authorities claim that in February 2026, Lopez Velazco and Diaz Jimenez negotiated the purchase and transportation of RPGs, machine guns, explosive devices, and other dangerous weapons from the Czech Republic to Mexico. The weapons were paid for using drugs that were smuggled into the United States by CJNG. Working with international law enforcement agencies, U.S. agents were able to arrest all four men in the Czech Republic in June. Also, on June 12, Mexican federal police forces raided Diaz Jimenez’s lab in Zapopan, Jalisco. Ildefonso Ortiz is an award-winning journalist with Breitbart News Foundation. https://www.dw.com/en/uk-seventh-arrest-.text: Skip to content Skip to main menu Skip to more DW sites https://p.dw.com/p/5Nr0T The US military's B1 bombers were withdrawn from RAF Fairford Image: Alastair Grant/AP Photo/picture alliance Advertisement Police in the UK arrested a man in connection with an alleged planned attack on a military air base used by the United States . The suspect, a 22-year-old British national, was arrested "on suspicion of preparation of terrorist acts," police said. Police arrested the man in London, and he is the seventh person taken into custody in connection with the incident in which three vans were stopped near the RAF Fairford air base in England's southwest on September 27. While no explosives were found in the van, police secured some gasoline in them, it said. The other six suspects were also men in their 20s, including one who is a dual UK-Iranian national. All six have been released on bail. Media reports in the UK said one of the initial suspects had informed the authorities of the incident, which police did not confirm. Police were alerted to suspicious activity next to the RAF Fairford base Image: Alastair Grant/AP Photo/picture alliance Bombers withdrawn US bombers have been seen taking off and landing at the air base, with the UK government allowing Washington to use it for "specific defensive operations into Iran." US President Donald Trump said Washington had withdrawn all B-1 bombers from RAF Fairford due to "threats" possibly linked to Iran. At the same time, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio played down specific threats. UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham also said there were "strong indications" that Iran had a role in the incident, with British authorities labeling it "major." The UK also insists the RAF Fairford air base is safe. Tehran rejected any involvement. Photograph: Zack Hall/Drury family/AP West Coast Teacher wounded in Oregon school shooting played dead after she was shot Becky Drury says she was hit by gunfire before she could intervene in attack that killed four, including three children Dani Anguiano Thu 22 Oct 2026 16.12 EDT Last modified on Thu 22 Oct 2026 16.13 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google Oregon shooting victims: three boys and female teacher killed at elementary school Read more A teacher wounded in last week’s shooting at a Bend, Oregon, elementary school shared her account of the incident, and how she was shot before she could intervene and “[pretended] to be dead”. Becky Drury was seriously wounded at Silver Rail elementary when Griffin J John II, a 16-year-old former student at the school armed with a shotgun, broke in and headed toward a special education classroom. He shot six people, killing Megan Lambert, a 25-year-old teacher, and three children, including five-year-old Rhoam Summer. Drury and Saylor Graham, a seven-year-old student, were also shot. Another teacher threw her phone at John and tackled him before a parent fatally shot the teen gunman. Drury, who is still hospitalized, released a statement on Wednesday. After the unimaginable happens, an Oregon town mourns: ‘You can’t stop thinking about the kids’ Read more “Here is what I remember: Once I realized something was happening outside, I ran to see what was going on. I then saw the shooter and immediately ran back into the classroom. I turned to shut the door behind me, but the shooter was already there. Before I could do anything more, he shot me at close range and I fell to the ground,” Drury said. Her left hand was almost completely severed, and her other arm was also badly injured, Drury said. “I could not get up, defend myself, or protect anyone else. So, I did the only thing I could do, which was to pretend to be dead in the hope he would not shoot me again,” she said. “I know there has been contradictory reporting about my actions that day, but the truth is I was shot before I had any chance to act.” Bystander who killed Oregon shooter identified as father of girls at elementary school Read more Drury’s account contradicted some reporting that she had thrown herself on top of a student in an effort to protect her, and the 54-year-old said she wanted to ensure “the events of that day and my actions in particular are reported accurately”. She described the violence as “unimaginable” and said “my heart is broken for everyone affected by this tragedy.” Public schools in the central Oregon city began reopening this week. Dozens of officers have welcomed students as they return to their classes. The shooting remains under investigation. The Bend police department said this week that the shotgun used in the incident was purchased legally. https://www.digi24.ro/stiri/externe/nato.text: Turcia şi Qatarul au semnat vineri un acord de apărare reciprocă, conform unei declaraţii a biroului preşedintelui turc Recep Tayyip Erdogan, care s-a întâlnit cu emirul Qatarului, Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad al-Thani la Istanbul, informează Reuters. „Preşedintele Erdogan a afirmat că vom continua să lucrăm împreună pentru a preveni reapariţia războiului în regiunea Golfului şi pentru a stabili o bază pentru dialog şi a obţine pacea”, a declarat preşedinţia Turciei într-un mesaj pe X, fără a oferi detalii despre acest acord. Informarea menţionează o declaraţie a preşedintelui Erdogan, potrivit căreia Turcia şi Qatarul lucrează pentru a-şi dezvolta şi diversifica parteneriatul energetic, iar cooperarea lor în industria de apărare va continua să crească. „Preşedintele Erdogan a declarat că acordul de apărare reciprocă, semnat astăzi de Turcia şi Qatar, va adăuga o nouă dimensiune fraternităţii noastre”, se adaugă în comunicat. În luna august, Turcia, Arabia Saudită şi Pakistan au semnat un acord comun de apărare la Mecca (acord denumit în mod popular „NATO al musulmanilor suniți” sau „NATO islamic”), reunind aliaţii sunni musulmani ai SUA într-o perioadă de conflicte în regiune. Parlamentul Turciei a ratificat săptămâna trecută acordul semnat la Mecca, deschizând calea pentru ca Ankara să trimită ajutor militar Arabiei Saudite, care se confruntă cu dificultăţi în a respinge atacurile militanţilor houthi din Yemen, susţinuţi de Iran. Conform acordului semnat de cele trei puteri regionale în august, un atac asupra uneia dintre părţi constituie un atac asupra tuturor. Urmărește știrile Digi24.ro și pe Google News
